name: polymeter
description: Polymeter: each track can have its own length; a shorter track loops its steps and every track starts again together when the pattern ends

branches.note: Pattern screen page 3: bind button 1 (Track Name; shared with copypattern); also binds Trk Len (the first button after humanize's and copypattern's: 2, 3 or 4) as kind 3
Pattern screen page 3 labels: button 6's (empty) text, the last of buttons 2..6; then Trk Len on its button
Pattern screen page 3 labels: button 6's (empty) second line; then Trk Len's: the length while held
Pattern screen page 3 labels: More's colors; Trk Len gets the active set
Pattern screen page 3 labels: More's data; Trk Len gets Pattern Name's
Pattern grid, note column: bl patgrid_draw_cell 0x6010b204; a short track's steps past its length in the column's empty color
Pattern grid, instrument column, 3-character text: bl patgrid_draw_cell 0x6010b204; a short track's steps past its length in the column's empty color
Pattern grid, instrument column: bl patgrid_draw_cell 0x6010b204; a short track's steps past its length in the column's empty color
Pattern grid, FX1 column: bl patgrid_draw_cell 0x6010b204; a short track's steps past its length in the column's empty color
Pattern grid, FX2 column: bl patgrid_draw_cell 0x6010b204; a short track's steps past its length in the column's empty color

itcm_branches.note: seq_process_track, micro-step 1: bl memcpy_small (thunk 0x1f514) copying the track's step into its work record -> mt_pm_step_copy(dst, src, seq, track): a short track's step mod its length
Roll: bl seq_distance_to_next_note_q 0x3958 (seq, track, step) -> mt_pm_roll_a: looks at a short track's steps mod its length
Roll: bl seq_distance_to_next_note_q 0x3958 (seq, track, step) -> mt_pm_roll_b: the same

words.note: Pattern screen encoder callback pat_jog 0x600c90a1 -> mt_pm_jog: sets the cursor's track's length while Trk Len is held
